name: The majority (al-jumhūr)
definition: The view of most grammarians, against that of one school or one scholar.
body: 'According to the majority' (ʿinda al-jumhūr) gives the received view while leaving room for others; it is weaker than 'by agreement' (bi-l-ittifāq, ijmāʿan) and is often set against 'and al-Akhfash held…' or 'and the Kufans allowed…'. In Ibn ʿAqīl and al-Ushmūnī the majority is usually the Basrans.
